tei:div.tei:p: (pa)༄༅// kye rdo rje'i bdag 'jug gi cho ga dbang la 'jug pa bzhugs// ༄༅// dpal kye'i rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga dbang la 'jug pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang dpal kye'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// skyabs mchog dkon mchog gsum rang bzhin// bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas// dbang nyid lam du bya ba'i phyir// de yi cho ga bshad par bya// dbang thob dam tshig rnam dag cing*// rnal 'byor gnyis la mnyam par gnas// bsnyen pa sngon du song ba yis// bdag nyid 'jug pa'i cho ga brtsam// de yang mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i gnas su/ 'dir dgos pa'i yo byad rnams bsags nas/ sa'i cho ga'i don du phyag gnyis pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas pas/ dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal gyi dbus su/ oṃ pri thi wī de wī/ zhes pas me tog gi tshom bu bkod la/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bam̐ las sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsis gang ba 'dzin zhing*/ bdag la phyogs par bskyed pa'i dpral bar oṃ mgrin par āḥsnying gar hūm̐ bkod nas/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'og tu 'phros pas sa'i lha mo/ 'khor klu dang sa bdag gi tshogs dang bcas pa spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs lha mo mdun bskyed la bstim pa la/ 'khor gzhan gyis bskor bar bsams nas/ yang 'od kyi snang bas dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs nas mchod la/ 'di la dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ dri ma thams cad dag rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsams nas/ lha rdzas su byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyi'i mchod pa rnams oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī'i sngags sngon du 'gro ba'i so so'i sngags kyis rim pa bzhin du dbul/ nang mchod kyis kyang mchod nas/ gtor ma oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs la/

oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sngon du 'gro ba'i a kā ro gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ ma ma rin chen sna tshogs 'dzin// kye yi rdo rje khros mchod pa'i// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// sa 'dir dkyil 'khor bri bar bya// shākya seng ge skyob pa yis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod nas/ bdag gis sems can thams cad kyi don du sa'i phyogs 'dir kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas/ bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang len par 'tshal bas/ sa'i phyogs 'dir bdag la gnang zhing*/ las kyi dngos grub kyang stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ rigs kyi bu khyod ci dga' bar spyod cig ces gnang ba byin par bsam mo// gtor ma gnyis pa dkar po'i phyogs snod du rung ba rnams la byin nas/ bdag gi dge ba'i stong grogs mdzod cig ces bsgo/ gsum pa nag po'i phyogs snod du mi rung ba rnams la byin nas/ sa phyogs 'dir ni slob dpon bdag /dkyil 'khor rgyal po kye rdo rje// bzhengs kyis 'di ni gnas pa'i bgegs// 'di nas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// slob dpon kho bos dpal he ru ka'i rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba/ gsang ba chen po'i las brtsam gyi/ dkyil 'khor chen po blta bar mi dbang ba'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig ces pa'i mthar drag po'i sngags brjod cing gu gul gyi dud pa dang*/ rol mo'i sgra drag tu byas pas/ bgegs thams cad byer bar bsams nas/ oṃ pṛ thi wī de wī sa pa ri wā ra badz+ra muḥzhes brjod pas/ sa'i lha mo 'khor bcas rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsams nas las kyi rjes bsdu'o// sa bslang ba'o// de nas gyo mo dang*/ sol ba dang*/ rus pa la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams phyung nas/ sa brnyan bzang pos bkang la 'thas par brdung ngo*// de ma grub na'ang sa brnyan bzang po dri bzang dang sbyar bas/

shar dang byang du gzhol zhing*/ me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa'i sa stegs gru bzhi pa byas pa'i steng dang khor yug kun tu lag pa gnyis gzhag cing*/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa ces brjod cing*/ lag mthil las 'od 'phros pas zug rngu thams cad sbyangs par bsam/ yang oṃ bhu khaṃ zhes brjod pas sa phyogs thams cad nam mkhar gyur par bsam/ yang oṃ me di nī badz+rī bha wa ban+dha hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod cing*/ lag mthil las 'od 'phros pas phyogs thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhir gyur par bsam mo// skyon sbyang ba'o// //de nas sa phyogs de nyid du kha shar du bltas pas bdag nyid 'dug la thun mong gi srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgoms nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes yang dang yang du brjod do// de nas rang gi snying ga nas g.yon pas rdo rje phur bu dang*/ g.yas pas rdo rje tho ba 'dzin pa'i khro bo bcu 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong bcus gtso byas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs thams cad bkug dkar po'i phyogs skyabs 'gro sems bskyed la bkod/ rang gi grogs byed du bcug nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor rdo rje phur bu btab par bsam zhing*/ oṃ gha gha/ ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣ+ṭān phaṭa/ kī la ya kī la ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ badz+ra kī la ya badz+ra dha ra ādz+nyā pa ya ti/ sarba bigh+nān kā ya wāk+tsitā badz+ra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas/ rdo rje tho bas brdung bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra mut+ka ra badz+ra kī la ya ā ko ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus thams cad bcom/ sdig pa thams cad bsregs/ rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas nas/ khro bo rnams rdo rje rwa ba'i kha khyer la 'khod de/ dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du srung ba mdzad par bsam zhing srung ba'i sngags yang yang brjod do// bgegs sbyang zhing bsrung ba'o// de nas sa'i phyogs 'dir dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya'o snyam du blos gzung ngo*// sa'i cho ga'o//

//de nas sta gon la 'jug pa'i tshe/ ba byung dang dri bzang gis byugs pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug tu chu bzhi sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pas bskor zhing*/ gos zung dang*/ nang mchod dang*/ gtor ma dang*/ rdo rje dril bu dang*/ cod pan la sogs pa dbang rdzas rnams bsags nas/ phyi ma red kyi tshe sgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pa 'khod la/ sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis der gnas pa'i 'byung po rnams la bsngos nas/ snod ma yin pa bskrad cing*/ snod dang ldan pa rnams la grogs bcol la/ gnas dang yo byad rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med la rgya che bar byin gyis brlab cing rol mo'i sgra rgya cher byas la/ oṃ badz+ra dharma ra ṇi'i sngags brjod do// de nas las kyi slob mas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba btab nas yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs la/ srung ba'i 'khor lo sngon du 'gro ba'i rim pa gnyis bsgoms nas bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas la/ bdag nyid phyag gnyis par bsdus te/ mchod rdzas rnams a mṛ tas bsang zhing*/ swa bhā was sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ hūm̐ las byung ba'i lha rdzas kyi mchod pa/ sa dang nam mkha' dang bar snang gang bar bskyed nas so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo// de nas sa bslang ba'i skabs ltar sa'i lha mo 'ba' zhig gi cho gas sa lhag par gnas par byas nas tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed la/ rol mo'i bar gyi phyi mchod sgrub thabs nas 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ lha rdzas las grub pa'i gos zung lha re re la'ang dpag tu med pa phul bar bsam zhing*/ srab 'jam yang ba lha yi gos// mi phyed rdo rje'i sku la gsol// mi phyed dad pas bdag 'bul na// bdag kyang rdo rje'i sku thob shog /oṃ bha ga wān la sogs pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra was+t+rā aḥzhes pas gos phul nas/ nang bdud rtsi dang yid las byung bas kyang mchod nas/ bstod pa rgyas par bstod la/

pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ hūm̐ he ru ka dpal dpa' bo che// rig pa'i rgyal por phyag 'tshal bstod// dkyil 'khor thugs rje'i rang bzhin can// mgon po bdag ni 'dri bar 'tshal// slob ma rnams la brtse ba dang*// khyed la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir// bcom ldan bdag ni gus pa la// de bas bka' drin mdzad par 'os// 'gro ba 'khor lo'i don mdzad pa'i// sangs rgyas bdag la dgongs su gsol// 'bras gnas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// sngags kyi lha gzhan gang lags dang*// 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha rnams dang*// gang yang 'byung po mthu chen dang*// sems can bstan la dga' ba dang*// gang su rdo rje'i spyan can rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// he zhes bya ba'i dkyil 'khor ni// yo byad ci 'byor pa dag gis// 'gro ba dag phyir bdag 'dri bas// bdag dang slob mar bcas pa la// thugs rjes thugs dpag mdzad nas su// dkyil 'khor par bcas thams cad kyis// thugs rjes dgongs nas gnang bar mdzod// ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis brlab par bsam pa ni lha sta gon no// sbyin sreg dang 'brel na skabs 'dir zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya'o// de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bum pa gnyis prog lnga'am bdun dang ldan pa'i mgul chings kyis bcings shing*/ bcud rnams dang bcas pa'i chus yongs su bkang ba la/ lo ma dang 'bras bur bcas pa'i shing gi yal gas khar brgyan nas/ rnam rgyal gyi bum pa'i steng du dri'i chus gang ba'i dung chos gzungs thag dang ldan pa'i rdo rje dang bcas pa gzhag cing*/ gtso bo'i phyag mtshan gdags/ las thams cad pa la sna tshogs rdo rje btags pa bsang zhing sbyangs pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba/

dpag bsam gyis shing gis khar brgyan zhing*/ lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa g.yog par bskyed nas/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du lha dgu so so'i gdan dang*/ las thams cad par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i gdan dmigs pa rnams kyi steng du/ ā li kā li las zla ba dang nyi ma kha sbyor phrag bcu bskyed la/ rnam rgyal gyi dbus ma mngon byang lngas gtso bo yab yum du bskyed pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs/ zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu ba'i thig le dgu phyogs mtshams brgyad dang las thams cad pa'i nyi zla'i bar du 'phros pa rnams/ so so'i phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan par gyur cing*/ so so 'dres pa las lha mo brgyad dang*/ las thams cad par bdud rtsi 'khyil pa sku mdog ljang gu/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pa sna tshogs rdo rje thugs ka dang*/ g.yon pa dril bu dkur 'dzin zhing*/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa bskyed nas/ thams cad la yan lag bzhi rdzogs su byas te/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la ni don yod grub pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo// de nas de rnams la mchod cing bstod nas rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas lha so so'i rgyud bskul nas/ sku'i cha thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing*/ gtso bo la snying po dang*/ lha mo rnams la so so'i sngags dang*/ las thams cad pa la oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa ces pa rnams ci rigs pa bzlas nas slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ dung chos kyi chu blugs pas lha rnams zhu ba las byung ba'i chur bsam mo// bum pa sta gon no// de nas gtor ma dang po kye rdo rje'i lha tshogs dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad la dbul lo// de nas yul gyi bya ba rnams gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad kyis mdzad par bsam zhing*/

rang dang 'brel pa rnams bdag nyid kyis byas nas/ sta gon gyi chos rnams kyang byas na 'gal ba med par bsam mo// de nas tshogs kyis phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod cing*/ lhag ma'i bar byas nas/ 'das pa'i ma gtogs pa'i gtor ma rnams gtang zhing*/ tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod nas/ oṃ badz+ro tiṣ+ṭha'i sngags dang phyag rgyas nam mkha' la bteg nas bzhugs pa la mchod pa rgyun mi 'chad par bya'o// de nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// sta gon no// nang par tho rangs ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis langs nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ badz+ra shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā badz+ra shud+dho3haṃ/ oṃ yo ga shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud+dho3haṃ/ zhes brjod cing dag pa gsum dran par byas nas sta gon gyi lha nam mkha' la gnas pa la mchod pa bya'o// rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bri ba'i tshul gzhan du shes par bya zhing*/ 'dir ras bris la brten pa'i tshul ni/ phyi ma red kyi tshe tshom bu'i gzhi de nyid kyi khor yug dang bcas pa ba byung lnga dri bzangs bdud rtsi dang bcas pas legs par byugs par gzhi bzang po'i steng du dkyil 'khor zhal shar du phyogs par bkram la/ khor yug kun tu mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma la sogs pa sngar bzhin du dgram mo// de nas sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor ma nas bzlas pa'i bar sngar bzhin du byas nas/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs la/ dkyil 'khor bsang zhing sbyangs pa'i ngang las thun mong gi srung 'khor rang gi bsgoms pa ltar bskyed pa'i dbus su/ lugs 'byung gi 'byung ba bzhi 'dres pa las gzhal yas khang dur khrod gdan dang bcas pa bskyed nas/ gdan re re'i steng du so so'i mngon byang lnga lngas lha dgu rdzogs par bskyed pa dang*/ bdag gis bsgoms pa'i rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor gnyis su med par bsres nas bdag nyid gtso bor gnas pa'i mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/

snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs nas zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ yum gyi mkhar babs pa lha dgu'i dkyil 'khor du gyur pa lha re re nas sbyor mtshams nas spros nas nam mkha'i khams thams cad khyab/ rang rang gi phrin las kyis sems can gyi don mdzad/ slar 'dus pa gzhi'i lha so so la thim/ yang rten gyi dkyil 'khor spros/ snod thams cad sbyangs pa rten gyi dkyil 'khor du gyur pa'i nang du/ gong du smin par byas pa'i sems can rnams lha dgu'i rnam pas bzhugs par bsams nas/ 'phros pa slar 'dus pa rnams rang gi rten gyi dkyil 'khor la thim par bsgom mo// de nas rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi skye mched dang*/ sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas/ rtsa ba'i sngags brjod cing rdo rje gsor la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis srung ba'i 'khor lo kha phye ba'i sgo nas/ sta gon gyi lha la mchod cing bstod la/ gau rī la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis rang la bstim mo// slar yang ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor gzhug pa nas/ rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar byas nas/ lha rnams byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir re re la dmigs shing*/ oṃ shrī badz+ra he ru ka dang*/ naṃ badz+ra nai rīt+m+ya la sogs pa lha so so'i mtshan sngon du 'gro ba'i yi ge brgya pa brjod do// sgrub pa'o// de nas bdag nyid gtso bo'i thugs ka nas phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis bye ba shar phyogs su gnas pa'i cho ga rnams bya ste/ thog mar mchod pa dang bstod pa sta gon ltar byas la/ sgrub pa'i grogs 'ga' zhig gis rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pas dkyil 'khor gyi gnas bsrung du bcug nas/ bdag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi khang pa'i phyi rol du/ dkyil 'khor la blta bar mi dbang ba'i 'byung po rnams la phyi rol gyi gtor ma sbyin par bya ste/ mgron gyi skabs su pad+ma dbus ma'i dbus su thugs rdo rje yab yum bskyed cing*/

dbul ba'i sngags/ oṃ in+da man chad gsum la sogs pas phul nas mi bskyod rdo rje man chad kyis bstod cing*/ phrin las gzhol ba la sogs pa bya'o// bye brag tu dkyil 'khor gyi bya ba mthar phyin par mdzod ces khyad par gyi phrin las bcol nas/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dha'i sngags kyis 'thor 'thung byin la/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar muḥdang lag pa sa la gtug cing se gol brdabs la/ sarba bhū ta gats+tshaḥsarba duṣ+ṭān gats+tshaḥzhes brjod la mgron gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ gtor ma rol mo dang bcas pas gzhi mdo'am chu bor bskyal lo// de nas rtsa ba'i sngags brjod pas bsrungs nas/ yi ge brgya pa brjod cing*/ dkyil 'khor la bskor ba'am/ bskor bar dmigs la de yan chad kyi 'gal 'khrul rnams bzod par gsol lo// sbyin sreg dang 'brel na skabs 'dir bya ste/ de'ang sta gon gyi tshe zhi ba dang*/ dngos gzhi la rgyas pa'i bya'o// de nas shar phyogs su 'dug la/ bdag nyid 'jug cing*/ gtso bo dang bla ma tha mi dad pa las dbang blang bar bya ste/ bla mas mdzad rgyu'i cho ga rnams des mdzad pa dang gsung bar bsam zhing bya/ las kyi bya ba rnams de'i thugs ka nas bye ba'i he ru ka phyag gnyis pa gcig gis mdzad par bsam/ slob ma'i bya ba rnams rang gis dngos su bya ste/ thog mar maṇ+ḍal phul la/ me tog dang bcas pa'i thal mo sbyar bas tsog pur 'dug la/ dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa ste// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab/ de nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi// la sogs pa lan gsum gyis rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed/

sras bcas sangs rgyas thams cad dang*// zhes pa la sogs pa lan gsum gyis sdom pa bzung nas/ a khaṃ wī ra hūm̐ gis gdong g.yogs bcing*/ me tog gi phreng ba gtad/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags dang las thams cad pa'i chus bsang*/ bdud rtsi lce la gzhag cing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlab/ bla mas bu khyod su yin ci la dga' zhes pas dris par bsam/ skal bzang bdag bde ba chen po la'o zhes pas lan gdab/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya zhes dri/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go zhes pas lan btab pas/ rigs dang mos pa nges par bya/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems su dmigs pa'i steng du/ rdo rje dkar po rtse mo lnga pa don dam pa byang chub kyi sems su dmigs nas/ dngos su rdo rje gtug cing*/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsit+ta ud+bā da yā mi su ra ti sa ma ya staṃ ho/ sin+dh+ya badz+ra ya thā su khaṃ zhes pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ spyi bor rdo rje gtugs la/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la'ang ma yin no// hūm̐ zhes pas gsang bar gdams nas/ gau rī la sogs pa bzhis yol ba'i nang du khrid par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes brjod do// phyi'i 'jug pa'o// de nas rang nyid shar phyogs kyi sgo khang du gnas pa la/ gtso bos spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub kyang thob par 'gyur na/ dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'i khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/

bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re/ zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dang*/ snying gar rdo rje bzhag nas/ hūm̐ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// yang spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes nyes dmigs kyi sgo nas dang*/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun blud nas/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥṭhaḥṭhaḥhūm̐ zhes gnyi ga'i sgo nas dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng phyin chad bu khyod kyis dpal he ra ka nga yin gyis ngas 'di byos shig ces bya ba de bu khyod kyis bya dgos so// nga la yang brnyas pa ma byed cig byas na ya nga ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas sems can dmyal ba chen por ltung bar 'gyur ta re/ zhes bla ma'i bka' nyan pa'i sgo nas dam la gzhag par bya'o// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi byin gyis rlobs shig dpal he ru ka bdag la dbab du gsol zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ phyi nang gi chos thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar rang bzhin med par shes pa'i rtogs pa brtan po bskyed pas/ dngos po la mngon par zhen pa dang bral ba'i ngang nas/ rang nyid rlung gi dkyil 'khor gzhu bdungs pa lta bu'i steng na gnas pa'i he ru ka zhabs gnyis bgrad par bsams nas/ de'i rkang mthil gnyis su dzhaiṃ ljang gu gnyis/ sum mdo me'i rang bzhin dmar po/ snying gar lam̐ las sa'i dkyil 'khor gru bzhi ser po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa/ mgrin par bam̐ las chu'i dkyil 'khor dkar po zlum po āḥs mtshan pa/ spyi bor yam̐ las rlung gi dkyil 'khor zla gam ljang gu has mtshan pa rnams dmigs nas/

'og gi rlung g.yos shing gtsubs dzhaiṃ mer gyur pa rkang pa'i nang nas zhugs shing gyen du song bas nang gi sum mdo'i me dang 'dres shing cher 'bar bas/ lus thams cad gang bas sdig pa dang rtog pa thams cad tshig snying ga'i sa bsregs/ mgrin pa'i chu bskol/ spyi bo'i rlung gis mnan/ rkang pa'i rlung gis bteg de'i tshe phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad char chen po 'bab pa ltar babs shing*/ dbang po dang ba spu'i sgo thams cad nas zhugs te thim pas he ru ka'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsgom zhing*/ byi la'i brun dang zla mtshan can gyi 'dom dkris kyi ras dang bcas pa'i gu gul bsregs pas bdug cing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha thams cad kyis/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha mahā kro dha ā we sha ya ā we sha ya/ s+t+waṃ bha ya s+t+waṃ bha ya/ ra ra ra ra/ tsa la ya tsa la ya/ hūm̐ a hā dzhaiṃ zhes 'brug gi sgra ltar bsgrags par bsam zhing yid gzung ngo*// des ye shes babs pa'i rtags ci rigs pa 'byung zhing*/ de brtan pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje rgya gram du bzhag nas/ oṃ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra zhes gsung bar bsam mo// ye shes dbab cing brtan par bya ba'o// de nas bla mas/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// bsod nams rim pa'ang de bzhin shog /rigs ni gang gi snod du 'gyur// 'di la bsod nams ci yod pa// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces lan gsum gyis gsol ba 'debs par bsams nas/ rang nyid dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'dug pa'am/ 'dug par bsams la/ zhe sdang rdo rjer phyag 'tshal bstod/ la sogs pas gsol ba btab nas/ oṃ pra tīts+tsha badz+ra hoḥzhes brjod nas me tog gang la phog pa'i lha la phul la/ oṃ pra ti grih+na s+t+waṃ i maṃ sa twa ma hā bā la zhes pas slar yang byin gyis brlab pa'i phyir spyi bor bzhag nas/

mig 'bras oṃ du dmigs la/ rdo rje sems dpa' deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba'i// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// he badz+ra pa sh+ya zhes pas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi he ru ka /dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// sngags dang phyag rgya'i byin gyis brlabs// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis// zhes pas dkyil 'khor bstan pa bltas la/ rten dang brten par bcas pa'i dkyil 'khor spyi dang bye brag nges par byas nas/ oṃ rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag zhugs so// oṃ rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor bdag gis de ring mthong*// oṃ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor chen po yi// dkyil 'khor du ni bdag dbang bskur// sa ma ya hoḥzhes brjod do// 'jug pa'o// de nas dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ byang chub rdo rjes sangs rgyas// mchod chen ci ltar stsal ba ltar// bdag kyang bskyab pa'i don gyi phyir// nam mkha'i rdo rje deng bdag stsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rang nyid dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi nang du rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang nyi mar bcas pa'i gdan la/ me tog gang la phog pa'i rnam pas gnas pa'i steng du/ gdugs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can phub/ sa dang bar snang thams cad mchod pa'i sprin gyi gang bas rang nyid la mchod cing*/ las byed pa'i he ru kas bdag gi byur dang skal ba ngan pa thams cad til la bstim pa mer bsregs nas/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya badz+ra sa twa s+ya sarba pā paṃ da ha na swā hā zhes me'i shis pa dang*/

chus bkrus shing*/ oṃ hūm̐ ḍa ḍi ta phaṭa ces chu'i shis pa dang*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥsarba pā paṃ ni tsa s+ya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpān a pa na ya hūm̐ gis skyor chu byin nas byur bsal ba mdzad nas/ sprul pa'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad gsung bar bsam zhing dngos su yang bkra shis brjod do// shes pa'i cho ga'o// de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga ni/ bdag dang dbang rdzas bum pa swa bhā was mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros/ sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pa las/ mi bskyod pa dgyes pa'i rdo rje sku mdog sngon po zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas pa rnams kyis rdo rje/ g.yon pa rnams kyis rdo rjes yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ yum mā ma kī sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pas yab la 'khyud pa/ rus pa dang rin po ches brgyan pa bskyed nas skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs la/ snying ga'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mi bskyod pa'i rnam pas spyan drangs/ dam tshig pa gnyis la gnyis su med par bstim/ dbang rdzas kyi lha la dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas btab nas/ de snyoms par zhugs pas zhu ba las byung ba'i dbang rdzas su bltas la/ gdan gsum tshang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams la/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol zhes gsol ba btab pas rigs lngas/ sangs rgyas rnams ni thams cad kyi// gsang gsum gnas las byung ba yi// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// rdo rje dbang bskur chen po sbyin// oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing*/ bum pa'i chus dbang bskur/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu blangs/ byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/

khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam/ dbang gi chu rgyun gyis rkang mthil yan chad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la/ slar yang mchod pa'i lha mo rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/ mi bskyod pa'i sgo nas chu'i dbang thob/ zhe sdang dag rnam par shes pa gnas gyur/ me long lta bu'i ye shes mngon du byas/ mi bskyod pa'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces don lnga'i rtogs pa dran par bya'o// de ltar tshul gnyis la yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bya ba 'di ni 'og ma rnams la'ang sbyar ro// āṃ las rin po che āṃ gis mtshan pa las/ rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu rnams 'dzin zhing*/ yum rin chen sgrol ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba la/ dbang gi lhas sangs rgyas rnams ni la sogs pa'i mthar/ rin chen dbang bskur chen po sbyin/ oṃ badz+ra mu ku ṭa a bhi ṣiñtsā mi badz+ra ra ga ta badz+ra sha li hoḥzhes pas dbu rgyan gyi dbang byin nas/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur la/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod nas/ cod pan gyi dbang thob/ nga rgyal dang ser sna dag tshor ba gnas gyur/ mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces dran par bya'o// dz+rīṃ las pad+ma dz+rīṃ gi mtshan pa las 'od dpag med dmar po pad+ma dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu rnams 'dzin zhing*/ yum gos dkar mo dang mnyam par sbyor ba la dbang gi lhas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun du rab grub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis longs// oṃ badz+ra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes pas rdo rje'i dbang byin nas bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur la/ 'od dpag med kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod nas/ rdo rje'i dbang thob/ 'dod chags dang*/

'du shes gnas gyur/ so sor rtog pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ 'od dpag med kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces don dran par bya'o// khaṃ las ral gri khaṃ gis mtshan pa las/ don yod grub pa ljang gu ral gri dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin zhing*/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba la dbang gi lhas/ oṃ badz+ra a dhi pa ti s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes pas dril bu'i dbang byin nas/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur la/ don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa la mchod nas/ dril bu'i dbang thob/ phrag dog dag 'du byed gnas gyur/ bya ba grub pa'i ye shes mngon du byas/ don yod grub pa'i bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces dran par bya'o// ming gi dbang 'di la ni dbang rdzas med de/ bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa las rnam par snang mdzad sku mdog dkar po/ 'khor lo dang des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin zhing*/ yum sangs rgyas spyan ma dang gnyis su med par sbyor ba la dbang gis lhas/ oṃ badz+ra sa twa s+t+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa mi badz+ra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes pas rang gi ming gi dbang byin nas bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur la/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan pa la mchod nas/ ming gi dbang thob/ gti mug dag gzugs gnas gyur/ chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes mngon du byas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi bag chags rgyud la bzhag ces dran par bya'o// dngos kun gang dang gang snang ba// gtso de rang gi lhag pa'i lha// chos rnams rang bzhin rnyog med dag /sangs rgyas ye shes blta bar gyis// zhes bla mas gsung bar bsam zhing de'i don yang dran par bya'o// rig pa'i dbang lnga'o// de nas pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje dkar po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po phyag gnyis pa rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba la dbang gi lha rnams kyis/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// phyag na rdo rje'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid+dhi badz+ra sa ma ya s+t+waṃ e ṣa bha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes pas rdo rje'i brtul zhugs byin pa lag pa g.yas pas snying gar bzung nas/ snying gi nang du yang rang dang 'dra ba'i rdo rje sems dpa' bsam pa ni brtul zhugs kyi dbang ste/ slob ma'i bya ba la dbang bar byas pas/ rdo rje slob ma'i dbang ngo*// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ mi ldog 'khor lo'i dbang bskur ba// mgon pos bdag la stsal nas kyang*// 'khor lo lha yi de nyid dang*// slob dpon phrin las yongs su gsungs// sangs rgyas kun gyi dam tshig dang*// sdom pa'ang bla na med pa gsungs// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ rang dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang*/ nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje sngon po hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ rdo rje 'chang sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin zhing yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor bar dmigs pa'i skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs ye shes pa dang gnyis su med par byas nas/ steng du gdungs dkar po gser gyi yu ba can dang*/ phyogs kun tu rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng ba dang*/ mchod pa'i sprin gyis bskor bas bdag nyid la mchod cing bla ma nyid kyis/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad la sogs pa dang*/ sarba ta thā ga ta'i sngags kyis lag pa g.yas par rdo rje gnang nas/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// oṃ ma hā badz+ra hūm̐ zhes rdo rje'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing thugs kyi dam tshig gnang*/

'di de sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// ces pas g.yon par dril bu gnang nas/ a srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam pa byed par 'gyur// oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥzhes dril bu'i de kho na nyid gsung zhing*/ gsung gi dam tshig gnang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes rjes su gnang ba byin nas/ shes rab bcu drug lon pa la// 'khyud pa'i tshul du byas pa las// srid pa'i bde ba shin tu chung*// sdug bsngal chen po dag bya'i phyir// shin tu bde ba dam pa'i thabs// dam tshig 'di ni rtag tu zung*// 'dod pa'i longs spyod thams cad la// ci 'dod par ni bsten bzhin du// rang gi lhag pa'i lha sbyor bas// bdag dang gzhan la mchod par gyis// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba du ni mi mdzad pa// phyag rgya dam tshig ces su bsgrags// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes phyag rgya'i dam tshig rgyas par gsungs nas/ bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur zhing*/ chu lhag ma yar lud pa las mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa la dbang gi lha thams cad kyis/ oṃ su pra tiṣ+ṭha badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes gsung zhing me tog gi char phab nas/ khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por mnga' phul bar bsam mo// de nas dkyil 'khor zhes ni gang bshad pa la sogs pa/ dkyil 'khor gyi de kho na nyid dang*/ rnam par shes pa dag pa chos kyi dbyings kyi ngo bo ni bcom ldan 'das/ gzugs kyi phung po dag pa me long lta bu ni gau rī la sogs pa lha'i de kho na nyid dang*/ de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la tshang ba slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid gsung bar bsam zhing*/

rdo rje slob dpon lus 'di la// rgyal ba'i sku ni rim bzhin gnas// 'di yi gzugs kyi phung po ni// bcom ldan rnam par snang mdzad do// tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste// 'du shes pad+ma gar dbang phyug /'du byed de bzhin rdo rje rgyal// rnam par shes pa mi bskyod pa// kun gyi ngo bo he ru ka /mdor na phung po lnga rnams na// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad yin// rdo rje skye mched bdag nyid de// byang chub sems dpa'i dkyil 'khor mchog /sa ni spyan ma zhes bya ste// chu yi khams ni mā ma kī// dkar mo sgrol ma zhes bya ba// me dang rlung du rab tu grags// zhes brjod la don dran par byas nas/ de nas rjes gnang gi rdzas rnams rim pa bzhin gnang nas tshig rnams gsung bar bsam zhing*/ deng nas brtsams te rdzogs sangs rgyas// sras dang bcas pa rnam rol phyir// rdo rje snyems ma'i rnal 'byor gyis// dga' ston bde ba'i mchod pa gyis// āḥzhes sgeg pa dang*/ sgeg dang bcas pa'i phreng ba 'phang*// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par bya// des ni bcom ldan 'bral mi 'gyur// phreng ba de yi rgyan yin no// oṃ zhes phreng ba dang*/ lus can kun la dam chos kyi// glu ni khyod kyis blang bar gyis// de yis bde gshegs dngos grub ni// myur du bde ba thob par 'gyur// gī zhes glu dang*/ de nyid thal mo'i gar gyis ni// sangs rgyas thams cad mchod par gyis// sangs rgyas 'du ba'i phrin las kyis// gar mkhan tshul du bsgyur bar gyis// hoḥzhes gar dang*/ rdzogs sangs rgyas la spos phul bas// brtul zhugs bzang pos legs bsgos pa// lus can bde gshegs cha lugs su// ye shes kyis ni tshim par gyis// hūm̐ zhes bdug spos dang*/ sangs rgyas rnams la me tog gtor// byang chub yan lag tshogs gyur pa// mtshan dang dpe byad 'bar ba yis// bde gshegs sku ni thob par gyis// bh+rūm̐ zhes me tog dang*/

chos kyi me ni legs sbar bas// rdo rje chos dang 'dra ba ru// sems can ma rig ldongs pa la// ye shes sgron mas gsal bar gyis// pra zhes mar me dang*/ rgyal ba rnams la dri phul bas// tshul khrims ting 'dzin shes rab dang*// rnam grol ye shes mthong ba yi// byang chub lus can rnams la bsgos// gaḥzhes pas dri ste/ lha mo brgyad kyi sgo nas mchod pa'i rjes gnang dang*/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling thog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badz+ra ni tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa laṃ hrīḥpraṃ/ zhes thur ma'i rjes gnang dang*/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun du byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don ni mnyam med byos// 'on kyang sangs rgyas sras su skye// zhes me long dang*/ thams cad nam mkha'i mtshan nyid de// nam mkha' la yang mtshan nyid med// nam mkha' dag dang mnyam sbyor bas// kun mchog mnyam pa nyid du gsal// zhes dril bu dang*/ hoḥde bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang*// rjes su chags par byos shig ces mda' gzhu dang*/ a badz+ra sa twa rdo rje sems dpa' me long ltar// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// bu khyod kyi ni snying la zhugs// rdo rje sems dpa'i rang bzhin gtso// gang yang sangs rgyas thams cad kyi bdag po byang chub kyi sems 'di nyid yin par shes par gyis shig ces pas me long ste/ sems can gyi don bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba lnga dang*/ badz+ra he tus rkang pa'i 'og tu 'khor lo dang*/ badz+ra bhak+ṣa ram̐ gyis lag pa g.yas par dung dang*/ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe aḥs g.yon par dril bu dang*/ as pang du po sti byin nas/ deng nas brtsams te sems bskyed pa// tsam gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor// khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// sngags spyod tshul gyi cho ga yis// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan 'dogs drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun kyang*// khyod la rtag tu bsrung ba mdzad// ces pa dang*/

'jig rten kun la thams cad du// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// ji ltar sna tshogs 'dul 'gyur ba'i// chos kyi 'khor lo rab tu bskor// de bzhin du rdo rje'i 'khor lo/ rin chen 'khor lo/ pad+ma'i 'khor lo/ sna tshogs 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ sems can thams cad la chos kyi dung bus/ sgra sgrogs/ bshad pa gyis zhes pa chos bshad pa'i rjes su gnang ba mdzad par bsam zhing brjod la don dran par bya'o// de ltar bskyed pa phyi'i dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas zhes dran par bya'o// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du/ bla ma longs skur dmigs pa la/ maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ khyod ni rnal 'byor ma tshogs yongs su bskor// khyod ni nyid kyi thugs kyis mchog brnyes pa// khyod kyis rgyu dang mi rgyu'i 'gro ba kun brgyan te// snying rje'i thugs kyis sems can sad mdzad pa// sgyu ma'i spros pas rdo rje bsgrub pa'i yid// he ru ka dpal rdo rje yid kyis dges// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs nas 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi gtor bas byin gyis brlab par bsgoms nas/ bla ma he ru ka yab yum snyoms par zhugs pa'i bde ba'i sgras de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug pa zhal du zhugs/ thugs kar 'od du zhu/ gsang ba'i gnas nas byang chub kyi sems kyi thig le'i rnam pas babs pa bdag gi lce thog du gnang bar bsam zhing*/ ji ltar 'das pa'i sangs rgyas kyis// sangs rgyas sras rnams dbang bskur ltar// bdag gis gsang ba'i dbang gis ni// sems kyi rgyun gyis dbang bskur ro// zhes gsung bar bsams nas/ dngos su bdud rtsi myangs pas lus thams cad gang zhing*/ rang bzhin brgyad cu'i rnam rtog 'gags nas/ gsung rnam par dag pa 'od dpag tu med par gyur par bsgoms la/

'bru gsum brjod cing gdong g.yogs phye nas/ bla ma shākya thub pa'i rnam par gyur pas mi 'jigs pa'i phyag rgya spyi bor gtugs nas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa/ sa 'og sa steng sa bla rnams su bhār+bhu wa swaḥ gang la ngas lung bstan pa 'di la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo dang bcas pa thams cad kyis byang chub chen por mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad de/ sngags 'di dang phyag rgya 'di'i mthu yin no// zhes lung bstan par bsam mo// de ltar bha ga'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag rang byin gyis brlab pa bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas zhes dran par bya'o// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// //de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du/ bla ma chos skur dmigs pa la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bcom ldan zhi ba chen po kye// rdo rje rnal 'byor gcig bzhed pa// mi phyed phyag rgya sgrub pa po// rdo rje sbyor las yang dag byung*// ji ltar khyod ni bdag nyid che// mnga' bdag bdag la'ang de ltar mdzod// 'khor ba 'dam gyi tshogs nang du// bying ba skyabs med bdag la skyobs// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab la/ gdong g.yogs nas 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ bdud rtsi gtor bas byin gyis brlab par bsgoms nas/ rang nyid kye'i rdo rjer dmigs pa la/ bla mas rig ma rdo rje bdag med ma gnang bar bsam zhing*/ lha mo dga' sbyin gnas sbyin ma// sna tshogs gzugs can yid 'ong ma// khyer cig khyer cig sems dpa' che// khyer la mchod pa rtag tu gyis// zhes gsungs pa dang*/ rig ma des/ bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin de// sha chen bsten par bu spro'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar tsum+ba na// bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes dris pa'i lan du/

bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par cis mi spro// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i pad+mar tsum+ba na// bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to// zhes lan btab pa dang*/ lha mo de mnyes nas/ gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bstan nas/ e ma nga yi pad+ma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// bya ba pad+mar ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag tu bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces spro ba bskyed nas pang du byon pa dang*/ slar yang lha'i sku gnyi ga gsal btab nas/ mkha' gsang dang skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs te/ lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya snyam du snyoms par zhugs pas/ 'khyud pa dang tsum+ba'i tshe sna tshogs pa la dga' ba dang*/ mnyam par sbyor ba'i tshe rnam smin la mchog dga'/ dpyod pa dang ldan pa'i tshe rnam nyid la dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ bde stong zung du chud pa'i tshe mtshan nyid dang bral ba la lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes nyams su myong bar bsam/ de nyid kyi tshe yas 'bab kyi dga' ba bzhi dang*/ mas brtan gyi dga' ba bzhi mngon du byas nas lhan cig skyes pa'i ngang la mnyam par gzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ 'dod chags dral ba lta bu yi// khams gsum na ni sdig med de// de bas 'dod la chags bral bar// khyod kyis nam yang mi bya'o// ma hā sa ma ya ha na hūm̐ phaṭa ces chags pa gsum gyi don la gdams nas/ phyag 'tshal te rang gi lus phul ba/ bla mas sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin 'gyur ba'i// slob ma 'di ni phul ba lags// zhes pas dkyil 'khor dang sangs rgyas thams cad la phul nas/ sngags dang rgyud rnams 'dzin gyur pa// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// lha rnams kun gyis mthun par gsungs// sems can rnams la rjes brtse bas// dkyil 'khor cho ga bzhin du bris// khyod kyis nan tan bskyed nas su// sgrub pa po rnams sngags la sbyor// sngags bshad tshul gyi cho ga yis// skye bo rnams la rtag tu shod// de ltar byas na sangs rgyas la// phan btags drin du gzo zhes bya// rdo rje 'dzin pa de kun yang*// khyod la rtag tu srung ba mdzad// ces pa dang*/

khams gsum gyi ni rgyal srid che// dpal ldan yon tan 'byung ba'i gnas// bdud tshogs kun las nges rgyal te// grong khyer mchog tu zhugs pa yin// zhes 'bras bu'i dbugs phyung nas/ slob dpon smad par mi bya zhing*// bde gshegs bka' las 'da' mi bya// spun la smad pa nyid mi bya// sems can rnams la gdug byams dang*// byang chub sems ni spang mi bya// bdag gzhan chos la smad mi bya// skal med de nyid gtam mi bya// bdag gi lus la nges mi smad// chos la yid gnyis spang bya zhing*// gdug la byams pa nyid mi bya// chos nyid tshad ni gzung mi bya// skal ldan sems can spang mi bya// dam tshig rtag tu bskyang bar bya// bud med nyid la smad mi bya// ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar// dkon mchog gsum ni spang mi bya// rtag tu dam tshig bsrung bar bya// rdo rje dril bu gzung bar bya// gtsug tor rtag tu gzung bar bya// rtag tu sbyin sreg dgang bar bya// rtag tu dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya// rtag tu bde gshegs rab gnas bya// 'byung po che la gtor ma sbyin// phyag rgya bcing ba rnam spang zhing*// mchod rten las ni mi bya ste// rdo rje gsum mchog phyag mi bya// dkyil 'khor la sogs lus kyi las// rmi lam du yang mi bya'o// slob dpon gzhan la phyag mi bya// bla ma'i rgan rabs phyag 'tshal lo// rtag par rgyun du sngags bzla zhing*// bsam gtan nyid kyang rnam par spyad// rtag tu slob ma bsdu bya zhing*// rtag pa ru ni bshad pa gyis// rtag tu sems can bskyang bar bya// rtag tu sangs rgyas cher mnyes bya// dzam+bha la la chu sbyin zhing*// las rnams thams cad yang dag spyad// bye ma'i las la mchod rten yang*// mkhas pas cho ga bzhin du bya// zhes lam dus kyi dbugs dbyung mdzad pa bsam zhing*/ ngag tu brjod la don dran par bya'o// de ltar kun rdzob byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du shes rab ye shes kyi dbang thob/

yid kyi dri ma dag dkyil 'khor 'khor lo bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu chos sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas zhes dran par bya'o// shes rab ye shes kyi dbang ngo*// de nas dbang bzhi pa'i don du/ bla ma ngo bo nyid kyi skur dmigs pa la maṇ+ḍal phul nas/ bdag nyid che khyod bka' drin gyis// gtso bo dbang bskur rnam gsum thob// de ring rin chen bzhi pa yang*// bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas/ gdong g.yogs la 'bru gsum brjod cing*/ bdud rtsis gtor bas byin gyis brlab par bsgoms nas lus skyil krung lag pa mnyam gzhag gi phyag rgya byas la bla mas/ ye shes 'di ni ches phra zhing*// rdo rje nam mkha'i dkyil lta bu// rdul bral mthar sbyin zhi ba nyid// khyod kyi pha ni khyod nyid do// zhes gsung bar bsams pa'i don dran par byas nas/ de la yid mnyam par gzhag go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis// de ring sdig las rnam grol 'gyur// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyis ni 'chi ba yod min zhing*// mi thub pa dang mi chod pas// cis kyang mi 'jigs dga' bar gyis/ srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro rnams las bton// zhes gzengs bstod pa mdzad par bsam zhing*/ brjod la don dran par bya'o// de ltar don dam pa byang chub kyi sems kyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bzhi pa thob/ lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma bag chags dang bcas pa dag rdo rje'i rba rlabs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas zhes dran par bya'o// dbang bzhi pa'o// //de nas gtso bos ji ltar bka' stsal ba// de dag thams cad bdag gis bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis dam tshig dang sdom pa bsdus te khas blangs nas/ deng nas brtsams te bdag bran du// khyod la bdag ni 'bul lags na// khyod kyis slob mar gzung ba dang*// cha yis kyang ni spyad du gsol// zhes pas lus dang longs spyod thams cad gtang rag tu dbul lo// de nas dbang blang ba'i yul dang*/

len pa po dang*/ len pa'i tshul gsum ka rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma ltar shes pa'i ngang nas/ gnyis su med pa'i ye shes kyi dngos grub kyang blang ba'i phyir/ oṃ nam mkha' skye ba mtshan ldan phyir// thog ma tha ma med pa'i mchog /sems dpa' rdo rje che rang bzhin// kye yi rdo rjer bdag grub mdzod// kun mchog dngos grub chen po ste// dbang phyug chen po lhag pa'i lha// rdo rje 'dzin pa kun gyi rgyal// mi 'gyur mchog tu bdag grub mdzod// nyes pa mi mnga' rtag pa ste// 'dod chags kun gyi rjes su chags// 'dod chags chen po dga' ba che// bcom ldan de nyid kyis grub mdzod// shin tu dag pa kun gyi mchog /gdod nas grol ba de bzhin gshegs// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// byang chub sems su bdag grub mdzod// dngos grub chen po kun gyi mchog /dbang phyug chen po phyag rgya'i mchog /grub pa'i rdo rje cher bstod pa// rdo rje snyems bdag bdag grub mdzod// sems can kun gyi yid khyab pa// sems can kun gyi yid la zhugs// sems can kun gyi yab gyur nyid// 'dod chags mnyam pa'i dam tshig mchog /ces pa dang*/ de nas bden pa'i stobs brjod pa ni/ shes rab thabs bdag dkyil 'khor gyi// bden pa'i byin rlabs gang yin pa// bden pa de yis mgon bdag la// khyod kyis 'dod pa rab rdzogs mdzod// chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces dbyangs dang bcas pa'am/ med kyang rung ste lan gsum brjod do// de nas gtor ma rnams sta gon gyi skabs ltar phul nas phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo/

lhag gtor bkra shis dang bcas pa'i bar cho ga las 'byung ba ltar byas nas/ mdun gyi dkyil 'khor la slar yang mchod pa dang bstod pa byas la/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub ji ltar 'dod pa rnams gsol ba btab nas/ las bsags pa 'bras bu dang ldan pa'i phyir/ bsngo ba dang smon lam yang rgya cher btab la/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang*// gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni// bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba// de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod// ces pa dang yi ge brgya pa yang brjod do// dkyil 'khor la ma bstim pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad// rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol// sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*// slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol// badz+ra muḥzhes pas gshegs su gsol lo// ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la bstim pa ni/ rab tu gnas pa mchog tu gyur pa'i phyir/ brtan par bzhugs su gsol nas/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol/ gtor ma nyid kyang rol mo dang bcas pas btang ste/ bdag nyid kyi gnas gsum bsrungs nas/ las kyi rjes bsdus la/ gnas skabs dang rjes su 'brel ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// tshul 'di ltar rtag tu byas na dbang lam du byas pa'i phyir/ mthar thug gi 'bras bu rdo rje 'chang chen po'i go 'phang myur du thob par 'gyur te/ dbang bskur yang yang sbyin ldan na// skye zhing skye bar dbang bskur 'gyur// de yis skye ba bdun na ni// ma bsgoms par yang rdzogs 'tshang rgya// zhes gsungs so// dbang sbyin pa'i tshul yang*/ thog mar gzhan gyi rkyen gyis rten 'brel bsgrig pa rgyu dus kyi dbang dang*/ dbang gi tshul de nyid yang nas yang du len pa rgyu dbang lam du byed pa dang*/ cho ga de nyid rang gi ting nge 'dzin gyis len pa rgyu dbang ting nge 'dzin gyis lam du byed pa dang*/

'jug pa spangs pa'i dbang nyid mdo rgyas gnas skabs dang sbyar ba rang gis len pa dbang nyid ting nge 'dzin gyis lam du byed pa dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis cig car dbang bskur bas 'bras bu la mtshams sbyor ba ste/ dbang sbyin pa'i tshul lnga las 'di ni gsum pa'o// ma bsgoms par 'tshang rgya ba ni lam gzhan la 'bad pa cher ma byas kyang 'grub pa'o// gnas skabs kyi 'bras bu ni zhar las 'grub pa nyid de/ 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces gsungs su/ dbang gi rnam par gzhag pa'ang bstan zin to// sangs rgyas grong khyer yid 'ong bar// bdag nyid zhugs nas dbang blang ba'i// tshul 'di dge slong dpal gyis bskul// sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar// dge ba de yis 'gro kun gyis// bla ma mchog las dbang thob nas// yang dag lam gyis grol byas te// rdo rje 'dzin par 'jug gyur cig /dpal kye rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor du bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'i cho ga dbang la 'jug pa zhes bya ba 'di ni/ stan gcig pa'i brtul zhugs la legs par gnas pa'i dge slong dpal gyi 'byung gnas zhes bya bas gsol ba btab cing*/ 'phrul gyi yig mkhan 'jam nyeg ces bya bas lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen byas nas dge slong 'phags pas/ me pho stag gis lo khrums kyi zla ba la/ dpal sa skya'i chos grwa chen por sbyar ba'o// bkra shis par gyur cig/ // ༈ gu rus dpar rtsa spel ba'o//
